constraint-dependencies reported as ignored for a transitive dependency (closed not_planned)
constraint-dependencies not respected when specified outside pyproject.toml

rationale: The report is very thin: no command, no log, no error, and the build failure is not described. A likely explanation is that the failing step is a build of a source dist where numpy/pandas are pulled as build requirements in an isolated environment; constraint-dependencies does not apply there and build-constraint-dependencies is the setting (not verified against docs, only 2 searches). Regression 0.11.3 -> 0.11.8 would make it a bug if constraints are truly ignored in normal resolution, so a maintainer must ask for the command and log first.
